newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Nestle boosts Perrier stake in U.S. - report.
newsitem.headline: Nestle boosts Perrier stake in U.S. - report.

text.p: Nestle SA told securities analysts last week that it had bought a minority stake in Perrier Group of America that it did not already own, an analyst for CS Equity Research said.
Company officials, who briefed analysts after reporting first-half results on Friday, were not immediately available for comment because of a local holiday in Vevey.

"During Friday's conference, Nestle announced the purchase (for an undisclosed sum) of the remaining 39.2 percent of the Perrier Group of America that it did not already own," CS analyst James Amoroso said in a research note.
He gave no more details, but said the move helped cut the amount Nestle paid to third parties significantly in the period.
